verdict.rationale: The CLI installs one skills collection into several agents in a single command (`-a claude-code -a opencode`). It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 75+ more agents, writes to per-agent `./<agent>/skills/` or `~/<agent>/skills/` paths, and symlinks every agent to one canonical copy; community comments confirm multi-harness installs and praise the agent-agnostic design. Missing for 10: documented per-harness instructions beyond the generic per-agent path table, and hands-on corroboration of an actual multi-agent install (the runtime probes only cover listing and non-interactive mode).
